items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: You remember, Milt, you and I made a record... I always said I was going to have Richard Davis... At last after 4 or 5 years I got all you people together.

ctx.x: The mere fact that you were there was a marvelous thing, and Mr. Eubie Blake, who was just as effervescent as anyone could possibly be. I don't think we mentioned - especially with the big bass players I got to try to mention every one of them because I would never want it said that I didn't mention all of the bass players. There was Charlie Ming s. There was Ray Brown. There was George Duvivier. There was Slam Stewart; and Mr. Ruff which produced the whole thing, and yours truly, so I think I did cover it.

...You remember, Milt, you and I made a record and I always had in my heart that I was going to make a record with 5 bass players. I always said I was going to have Richard Davis; I always said I was going to have George Duvivier; I always said I was going to have Ray Brown... And I went on down the line. But when we sat in the back room, I said, "Now I got all you people here and I'll go out here with my drum and I'll kill all you people... At last after 4 or 5 years I got all you people together. You must…
Oh, we have a wonderful bass choir. We have a very beautiful bass choir and I'm very proud of it.
